content.text:
The following codelist contains codes that indicate a diagnosis of Hidradenitis Suppurativa. "Hidradenitis" (M25y1) is the parent code which is commonly used to refer to Hidradenitis Suppurativa in the absence of other specified types of hidradenitis (which are rare).

| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| M25y1 | Hidradenitis |
| M25y1-1 | Hidradenitis suppurativa |

content.text:
The following codelist contains diagnosis codes for **Wrist fracture**, including fractures of the carpal bones (scaphoid, lunate, triquetrum, pisiform, trapezium, trapezoid, capitate, hamate), distal radius, distal ulna, and specific named fractures such as Colles', Smith's, Barton's, and Galeazzi. It also includes fracture-dislocations of the wrist.

Because required codes are missing, the submission does not meet the criteria.
